ride.askHint: Nothing that suits you? Ask the drivers who often make this trip or drive around there. A few of them are told, drivers with an area there see your request in their list, and your inbox tells you when a drive that fits is posted.

ride.askSentDemo.other: Demo request: it only reaches fictional demo drivers. {count} were told: {names}. Sign out and continue under one of these names to see the request arrive.

ride.searchHint: We look for drivers who pass near your start and your destination around that time. The closest in time and place come first; you get to the pickup and from the drop-off on foot or by public transport.
